scope: Offline Directus SDK login response parity
contract: Python and TypeScript expose the Directus login response fields. TypeScript retains its existing token/refreshToken aliases and also returns access_token, refresh_token, expires, and expires_at from the SDK response.

validation.python: python3 -m pytest tests/test_sdk.py tests/test_sdk_schema_parity.py tests/test_sdk_method_parity.py -q — 81 passed

boundaries: Synthetic authentication responses and mocked clients are used; no credential or HTTP request is made.
The response includes authentication values already returned by Directus to the caller; this does not alter server authorization or Gateway sessions.
